# ISummerVestingWalletFactory
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/gov-contracts/src/interfaces/ISummerVestingWalletFactory.sol)

**Title:**
ISummerVestingWalletFactory

Interface for the factory that deploys SummerVestingWallet instances and tracks their owners


## Functions
### createVestingWallet

Creates a new vesting wallet for a beneficiary


```solidity
function createVestingWallet(
    address beneficiary,
    uint256 timeBasedAmount,
    uint256[] memory goalAmounts,
    ISummerVestingWallet.VestingType vestingType
)
    external
    returns (address newVestingWallet);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`beneficiary`|`address`|Address of the beneficiary to whom vested tokens are transferred|
|`timeBasedAmount`|`uint256`|Amount of tokens to be vested based on time|
|`goalAmounts`|`uint256[]`|Array of token amounts to be vested based on performance goals|
|`vestingType`|`ISummerVestingWallet.VestingType`|Type of vesting schedule|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`newVestingWallet`|`address`|The address of the created vesting wallet|


### vestingWallets

Gets the vesting wallet address for a given account


```solidity
function vestingWallets(address owner) external view returns (address);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`owner`|`address`|The address of the account|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`address`|The address of the vesting wallet|


### vestingWalletOwners

Gets the owner of a vesting wallet for a given account


```solidity
function vestingWalletOwners(address beneficiary) external view returns (address);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`beneficiary`|`address`|The address of the vesting wallet|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`address`|The address of the owner|


## Events
### VestingWalletCreated
Emitted when a new vesting wallet is created


```solidity
event VestingWalletCreated(
    address indexed beneficiary,
    address indexed vestingWallet,
    uint256 timeBasedAmount,
    uint256[] goalAmounts,
    ISummerVestingWallet.VestingType vestingType
);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`beneficiary`|`address`|The address of the beneficiary|
|`vestingWallet`|`address`|The address of the created vesting wallet|
|`timeBasedAmount`|`uint256`|The amount of tokens to be vested based on time|
|`goalAmounts`|`uint256[]`|The amounts of tokens to be vested based on goals|
|`vestingType`|`ISummerVestingWallet.VestingType`|The type of vesting schedule|
